{{Top|leg}}
The '''Mental boost system''' was an advanced upgrade of the [[mental boost implant]]. This device was designed to stimulate the neural pathways of the [[Brain/Legends|brain]] so as to provide a noticeable increase in all mental attributes, making it a valuable implant of its type.

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, the playable character must have a constitution attribute of 16 or higher.
